name: How do I know if a home issue actually needs repair or if it can wait?
description: Look for water stains, soft wood, growing cracks, drafts, or anything that keeps getting worse. If the problem is changing, it usually needs attention.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a home issue actually needs repair or if it can wait?

acceptedAnswer.text: A repair is usually needed when you see water stains, soft or spongy wood, peeling paint, drafts, unusual noises, cracks that grow, or doors and windows that no longer work smoothly. In Denver-area homes, moisture and drainage issues are especially important to watch because they can damage walls, trim, and foundations over time.
